stops.title: Sir John Soane's house of curiosities, top-lit and full of mirrors
stops.travel_text: Getting there: about 11 min on foot from Covent Garden station.
stops.approach: Walk south to Lincoln's Inn Fields and number 13.
stops.what: You squeeze through an architect's house kept exactly as he left it in 1837, packed with ancient marbles, paintings and models, lit from skylights and scattered with mirrors.
